Rashi on Berakhot 62a:1:1.hebrew: אחר רבי יהושע וכו' - וביהודה הוה:
Rashi on Berakhot 62a:1:1.english: After Rabbi Yehoshua, etc. - And [this incident] took place in Judea.

Rashi on Berakhot 62a:1:2.hebrew: עד כאן - כלומר, כל זה העזת פניך בפני רבך, שנסתכלת בכל אלו:
Rashi on Berakhot 62a:1:2.english: To this extent - That is to say: You acted with such brazenness in the presence of your teacher, that you observed all of these [actions]?

Rashi on Berakhot 62a:3:1.hebrew: דשח ושחק - עם אשתו, שיחה בטלה של ריצוי תשמיש:
Rashi on Berakhot 62a:3:1.english: Chatted and laughed - With his wife — idle conversation to appease [her for] marital relations.

Rashi on Berakhot 62a:3:2.english: And saw to his needs - And engaged in marital relations:

Rashi on Berakhot 62a:3:3.hebrew: כדלא שריף תבשילא - כאדם רעב, כמו שלא שמשת מטתך מעולם, שאתה נוהג קלות ראש זה לתאותך:
Rashi on Berakhot 62a:3:3.english: Like one who has not sipped a cooked dish - Like a hungry person, as though you had never engaged in marital relations in your life, that you conduct yourself with this levity for your desire.

Rashi on Berakhot 62a:3:4.english: Sipped - Humer in Old French [meaning to sip].

Rashi on Berakhot 62a:4:1.english: Because it is close to the mouth - People are accustomed to extending it to the mouth.

Rashi on Berakhot 62a:4:2.english: Because one ties phylacteries with it - Onto his left arm.

Rashi on Berakhot 62a:4:3.hebrew: טעמי תורה - נגינות טעמי מקרא של תורה, נביאים וכתובים. בין בניקוד שבספר, בין בהגבהת קול ובצלצול נעימות הנגינה של פשטא ודרגא ושופר מהפך — מוליך ידו לפי טעם הנגינה. ראיתי בקוראים הבאים מארץ ישראל:
Rashi on Berakhot 62a:4:3.english: Cantillation notes of the Torah - The melodies of the biblical cantillation notes of the Torah, Prophets, and Writings. Whether in [pointing to] the notation in the book, or in the raising of the voice and the melodious ringing of the tune of pashta, darga, and shofar mahpakh — he moves his hand according to the melody of the accent. [So] I have seen among the readers who come from the Land of Israel.

Rashi on Berakhot 62a:6:1.hebrew: מן הנחשים ומן העקרבים ומן המזיקין - דמתוך צניעתו מתנהג בנחת ובשתיקה, ואין הנחשים מרגישים להתקנאות בו, ואף המזיקין חסין עליו:
Rashi on Berakhot 62a:6:1.english: From snakes, and from scorpions, and from demons - For out of his modesty, he conducts himself gently and quietly, and the snakes do not sense [him] so as to be provoked against him, and even the demons spare him.

Rashi on Berakhot 62a:6:2.english: His dreams will be settling for him - For the demons do not frighten him.

Rashi on Berakhot 62a:7:1.hebrew: קבלה - מסורת ומנהג שקבלנו מרבותינו בבית הכסא:
Rashi on Berakhot 62a:7:1.english: Tradition - A tradition and custom that we received from our teachers regarding [conduct in] the bathroom.

Rashi on Berakhot 62a:7:2.hebrew: קבלה דיסורי שתיקותא - שלא יבעט ביסורין הבאים עליו:
Rashi on Berakhot 62a:7:2.english: The acceptance of suffering [is] silence - That he should not kick against the suffering that comes upon him:

Rashi on Berakhot 62a:8:1.hebrew: מרביה ליה אימרא - מגדלת לו שה, ומלמדתו שהולך עמו תמיד:
Rashi on Berakhot 62a:8:1.english: [She] raised a lamb for him - She raised a lamb for him, and trained it to always go with him:

Rashi on Berakhot 62a:8:2.hebrew: שעיר - שד של בית הכסא דומה לשעיר, ועליהם נאמר (ישעיהו י״ג:כ״א): "ושעירים ירקדו שם":
Rashi on Berakhot 62a:8:2.english: A goat-demon - The demon of the privy resembles a goat, and concerning them it is stated (Isaiah 13:21): "And satyrs shall dance there."

Rashi on Berakhot 62a:9:1.hebrew: אמגוזא בלקנא - נותנת אגוז בספל של נחשת, ומקרקשת בו מבית, והוא נפנה כנגדה מבחוץ:
Rashi on Berakhot 62a:9:1.english: A nut in a basin - She would place a nut in a copper basin and rattle it from inside, while he relieved himself opposite her from the outside.

Rashi on Berakhot 62a:9:2.hebrew: בתר דמלך - ונעשה ראש ישיבה, צריך שימור טפי מפני המזיקים, שמתקנאים השדים בתלמידי חכמים יותר משאר בני אדם:
Rashi on Berakhot 62a:9:2.english: After he reigned - And became head of the yeshiva, he needed greater protection from harmful spirits, for demons are more envious of Torah scholars than of other people.

Rashi on Berakhot 62a:9:3.hebrew: כוותא - חלון כנגד מקום שהוא נפנה שם, אחורי הבית:
Rashi on Berakhot 62a:9:3.english: A window - A window opposite the place where he would relieve himself, behind the house.
